items.title: Spanish Wine Strengthens Global Position as Barcelona Wine Week Names New President for 2027
items.summary: Spanish wine continues to gain momentum across European and international markets, driven by rising quality, stronger premium positioning and increasing recognition of its diverse wine regions. Against this positive backdrop, Barcelona Wine Week (BWW), Spain’s leading trade fair…

items.title: Lactalis Canada To Acquire Agropur’s Fine Cheese Division
items.summary: Lactalis Canada Inc has reached a definitive agreement with Agropur Cooperative to acquire the assets of its fine cheese division.

items.title: Carrefour Belgium Steps Up Commitment For Balanced Nutrition
items.summary: Carrefour Belgium is strengthening efforts to promote balanced nutrition, in line with recommendations from Belgian Food Council for Prevention.

items.title: Marks & Spencer Opens Its Largest Standalone Food Store
items.summary: UK retailer Marks & Spencer has announced the opening of its largest standalone food store to date in Godalming, Surrey.

items.title: Refresco Names Minsok Pak As President, Chief Strategy And Transformation Officer
items.summary: Refresco has appointed Minsok Pak as its new president, chief strategy and transformation officer, effective 15 July 2026.

items.title: Consumers Respond To Food Benefits, Not 'Resilient' Agriculture Messaging, EIT Food Finds
items.summary: Consumers want healthy, tasty, trusted food, but 'regenerative' tech terms alone won't win them over, says EIT Food research.
